notes.title: Spring Sale & Big News: New Games, Cozy Puzzles, and More Hidden Cats Await!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Kittenrock adventurers!

We’re always grateful for your love and support, and we’re thrilled to share some big news about upcoming games, plus some great deals in the Spring Sale!
Complete Your Hidden Cat Collection!

Did you enjoy Kittenrock? Expand your collection with our Purrfectly Hidden Cats Bundle, featuring Kittenbay and Hidden Cat Memories at a special discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

Looking for even more adventures? Pawsome Hidden Cats: Kittynawa is also on sale, so now’s the perfect time to dive into its magical world of hidden feline mysteries!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841060/Pawsome_Hidden_Cats__Kittynawa/

Exciting News: Two New Games on the Way!

We’re excited to announce Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game, launching in Q2 2025! This cozy new experience brings a fresh take on relaxing puzzle gameplay, featuring original artwork from Bleeding Moon Studio. This is not a hidden object game—it’s a beautiful, handcrafted spot-the-difference experience!

📝 Wishlist Déjà View now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581940/Deja_View__A_Spot_The_Difference_Game

We’re also thrilled to share that Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids will launch in Late Q4 2025! This relaxing creature collector lets you build and customize magical ponds filled with adorable mermaid cats.

📝 Wishlist Mermeows now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457460/Mermeows_Chill_Cat_Mermaids/

More Hidden Cat Games in the Works!

We’re currently designing two more hidden cat games! They’re still in very early production, so we don’t have a release date yet, but we can’t wait to share more with you soon. Stay tuned for more cat-finding fun!

Join the Community!

We’d love to hear from you! If you enjoy Kittenrock, consider leaving a review, and don’t forget to wishlist our upcoming games to support our work and stay updated.

Thank you for being part of our cozy gaming family. Enjoy the Spring Sale, and we’ll see you soon with more purrfect adventures!

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: Exciting Projects + Great Deals! Don’t Miss the Bundle Discounts This Sale!

Hello, fellow adventurers!

Cheers,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Social Chatter Achievement fix.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is a small patch aimed at improving the triggering mechanism for Achievements, specifically to address the persistent issue where the Social Chatter Achievement (click all humans) fails to activate to some players. We hope this update will completely eradicate the problem. While the fix has worked for us, we recommend that those who have encountered this issue perform a full reset from within the game after applying the update.

Thank you, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused by this bug.

Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: 🌟 A Purr-fect Achievement for "Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock"! 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Hello, wonderful cat detectives,[/b]

We're over the moon to share that "Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock" has reached an incredible milestone: 100 reviews with a 100% positive rating on Steam! This achievement is a testament to the love and enthusiasm you all have shown for our game, and we couldn't be more grateful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840768/289a5f5ce5e162252845e5e42ea55fd5b3da9e2a.png[/img]

A huge thank you to everyone who has played, reviewed, and recommended our game to fellow cat enthusiasts. Your support means the world to us and fuels our passion for creating engaging and fun experiences.

As we celebrate this milestone, we want you to know that the journey doesn't end here. We're already hard at work on the next game in the "Purrfectly Hidden Cats" series. While we're not quite ready to reveal the details, we're excited about the new adventures and challenges we're designing for you and our feline friends.

Your feedback has been incredibly valuable in shaping "Purrfectly Hidden Cats," and we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us. It's your insights and ideas that help us make our games better and more enjoyable.

Thank you again for being an amazing community and for making "Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock" a success. We're excited about the future and can't wait to bring you more purr-fectly hidden adventures!

Stay curious and don't forget to check our other games if you haven't already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464090/Purrfectly_Hidden_Cats__Kittenwood/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695080/Purrfectly_Hidden_Cats__Kittenbay/

Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.2 - Achievement Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've received reports about a random bug affecting some players, where certain achievements weren't triggering. We've conducted some bug extermination and are almost certain we've eliminated that nasty random bug. However, if you encounter it again (fingers crossed that you won't), please report it so we can tackle it once more, this time with even bigger guns :D

Thank you all, and enjoy the game!

Gemcraft Games Team
